{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The attacker bytes are interpreted as a PROXY v2 header."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"The declared length is compared to the struct size rather than the input buffer capacity."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":240,"var":"from/to","code":"from->sin6_addr = hdr->addr.ip6.src_addr; to->sin6_addr = hdr->addr.ip6.dst_addr;","note":"The TCP6 branch copies attacker-controlled addresses into the request proxy state."},
